vibe: Mechanical, reliable, hazard-aware, precise, blueprint feel. Focuses on high-contrast scannability for harsh industrial environments and control rooms.

headings.strategy: Bold, authoritative, high-legibility. Used for metrics, dashboard KPIs, and module titles.

body.strategy: Technical, tabular, crisp. Perfect for dense data tables, product specs, and forms.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Control Room Grid. Dense, rigorous, utilitarian. Every pixel must serve a purpose. High contrast dividers over empty space.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-4 or gap-px with border-collapse logic.
spacing_and_layout.padding: p-4 sm:p-6 for module containers. p-2 sm:p-4 for table cells and dense widgets.
spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-none (0px) or maximally rounded-sm (2px) for an angular, structural metal feel.

surfaces.strategy: The 'Technical Grid' Look. Avoid soft shadows. Expose the skeleton.
surfaces.cards: Flat background (bg-zinc-900 or bg-black), 1px sharp solid border (border-zinc-800), zero drop shadow. On hover, border changes to brand yellow (border-yellow-400) rather than lifting up.
surfaces.glass: Not recommended for industrial apps, use solid opaque surfaces for maximum legibility.
surfaces.active_states: Use glowing left-borders (border-l-4 border-yellow-400) for active sidebar items or selected rows.

motion.philosophy: Mechanical and instant. No slow easing. 0.15s max transition times.
motion.hover: Instant color snaps or sharp borders. No translation/lifting.

component_usage.tables: Dense, striped rows (bg-transparent odd / bg-zinc-900/50 even). Yellow highlights on hover.
component_usage.buttons: Sharp edges, flat. Primary: bg-yellow-400 text-black hover:bg-yellow-500. Secondary: border border-zinc-700 bg-transparent text-white hover:border-yellow-400.
component_usage.inputs: bg-black border border-zinc-700 rounded-none focus:border-yellow-400 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-yellow-400 text-white.
component_usage.badges: Sharp rectangular. Warning uses hazard yellow, Success uses Kelly Green, Error uses Signal Red.
component_usage.charts: Recharts. Tooltips should have stark black backgrounds with yellow borders. Grid lines should be faint zinc-800.
component_usage.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (solid/regular) or Lucide (stroke-width: 2) for crisp technical metaphors.

login_background.description: Industrial warehouse interior with steel beams. Use with a heavy black overlay (bg-black/80) to ensure login form readability.

scaffolding_hero.description: Close view of scaffolding attached to a building. Good for hero images or module headers.

product_placeholder.description: Detailed view of steel scaffolding. Use as a fallback for product images in the inventory table.

empty_state_graphic.description: Yellow caution sign. Use this for 'No Data Found' or system alerts in a creative way.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a dark-theme only industrial app. Ensure all backgrounds default to zinc-950 or black.
Do NOT use soft rounding (rounded-xl, rounded-2xl). Stick to rounded-none or rounded-sm.
For CRM follow-ups, include WhatsApp integration via wa.me links (e.g., https://wa.me/1234567890).
For Emails, use mailto: links (e.g., mailto:buyer@domain.com).
Dashboard must feel like a mission-control screen. Dense, metric-heavy, no wasted white (black) space.
Use data-testid attributes on all buttons, links, and forms for reliable testing.
Include a sidebar navigation (dark zinc-950) with active states highlighted by a thick yellow left border.
Avoid Shadcn 'Cards' out-of-the-box styling; strip out shadows and soft radius. Replace with 1px border and flat backgrounds.
